description: This file defines configuration parameters for the Spark Worker component, including resource files, timeouts, retries, cleanup settings, UI configurations, and worker ID patterns.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Object containing Spark Worker configuration constants and settings.

methods.name: SPARK_WORKER_RESOURCE_FILE
methods.description: Configuration for the path to the resources file allocated to the worker.

methods.name: WORKER_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Configuration for the worker timeout duration.

methods.name: WORKER_INITIAL_REGISTRATION_RETRIES
methods.description: Number of retries for initial worker registration.

methods.name: WORKER_MAX_REGISTRATION_RETRIES
methods.description: Maximum number of registration retries for the worker.

methods.name: WORKER_DRIVER_TERMINATE_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Timeout for driver termination in the worker.

methods.name: WORKER_CLEANUP_ENABLED
methods.description: Flag to enable or disable worker cleanup.

methods.name: APP_DATA_RETENTION
methods.description: Retention period for application data cleanup.

methods.name: PREFER_CONFIGURED_MASTER_ADDRESS
methods.description: Preference for using a configured master address.

methods.name: WORKER_UI_PORT
methods.description: Port configuration for the worker UI.

methods.name: WORKER_UI_RETAINED_EXECUTORS
methods.description: Number of retained executors in the worker UI.

methods.name: WORKER_UI_RETAINED_DRIVERS
methods.description: Number of retained drivers in the worker UI.

methods.name: UNCOMPRESSED_LOG_FILE_LENGTH_CACHE_SIZE_CONF
methods.description: Cache size for log file length in the worker UI.

methods.name: WORKER_DECOMMISSION_SIGNAL
methods.description: Signal used to trigger worker decommission.

methods.name: WORKER_ID_PATTERN
methods.description: Pattern for generating worker IDs based on String.format.
